answer_text:
Here are some great places where you can order a birthday cake online:

---

### 🎂 1. **Bake Me A Wish** (bakemeawish.com)
Bake Me A Wish began in 2005 as a premier nationwide service for gourmet birthday cake delivery, with cakes made using only the finest, freshest ingredients by their award-winning New York bakeries. They go beyond traditional vanilla and chocolate — offering a wide range of flavors like Tiramisu, Salted Caramel, Tres Leches, Limoncello, Boston Cream, and Coconut Cream.

---

### 🎂 2. **Milk Bar** (milkbarstore.com)
Milk Bar is best known for its playful and innovative approach to classic desserts. Their cakes have a distinctive naked frosting style with no outer frosting layer on the sides, topped with cake truffles. Their iconic Birthday Cake is a funfetti-inspired vanilla cake layered with frosting and rainbow sprinkles. You can select your delivery date at checkout up to 30 days in advance, and it's recommended to schedule delivery at least 3 or more days ahead of your celebration.

---

### 🎂 3. **Goldbelly** (goldbelly.com)
Goldbelly curates standout cakes from America's most famous bakeries, featuring favorites like chocolate cakes, red velvet cakes, birthday cakes, cookie cakes, bundt cakes, and more. Top bakers including Carousel Cakes, Daisy Cakes, and We Take the Cake ship birthday cakes — including gluten-free, kosher, nut-free, and Paleo options — nationwide through Goldbelly.

---

### 🎂 4. **Harry & David** (harryanddavid.com)
Their gourmet cakes, specialty desserts, and cheesecakes are handcrafted in their Southern Oregon bakery and delivered nationwide. They offer classic birthday cakes in chocolate, vanilla, and confetti; decadent cheesecakes; and seasonal & specialty flavors like tiramisu, lava cake, carrot cake, strawberry, and limoncello.

---

### 🎂 5. **Magnolia Bakery** (magnoliabakery.com)
If you want good old-fashioned birthday cake, Magnolia Bakery is a great option — they take simple, classic flavors like vanilla, chocolate, and carrot cake and make them phenomenal with high-quality ingredients.

---

### 🎂 6. **Whole Foods Market** (wholefoodsmarket.com)
Many Whole Foods Market locations offer a selection of cakes that can be ordered ahead online for easy pickup in store. From their cult-favorite Berry Chantilly Cake to decadent Chocolate Eruption Cake, their cakes are made with trustworthy ingredients — unbleached flour, cage-free eggs, and no hydrogenated fats or high-fructose corn syrup.

---

### 🎂 7. **Publix** (publix.com) *(in-store pickup)*
Publix hand-decorates custom cakes in-store and offers a wide selection of themes featuring favorite sports, TV shows, and movies, as well as customizable options for flavor, filling, and icing. You can design and order your Publix cake online for in-store pickup, and it just needs to be ordered 24 hours before your event.

---

Whether you want nationwide shipping or local pickup, there's a great option for every taste and budget! 🎉
